question: Who taught ChatGPT's safety filter what violent and abusive text looks like?
answer: Workers in Nairobi. To teach a filter to catch harmful text, OpenAI needed tens of thousands of examples labelled by hand; through an outsourcing firm, Sama, Kenyan staff read and tagged passages describing sexual abuse, torture and suicide. In 2023 TIME reported their take-home pay at about $1.32 to $2 an hour.
move: Ask who did the unpleasant work that makes a product feel clean.
reference: Perrigo, Exclusive: OpenAI Used Kenyan Workers on Less Than $2 Per Hour to Make ChatGPT Less Toxic, TIME, 2023
